prompt.role: Senior React + TypeScript + Tailwind; Figma-aligned; design tokens from repo (colors, typography, spacing).
prompt.context: Reusable design-system components; Figma Code Connect: props and enums align with Figma component properties.
prompt.instruction: Create a design-system-driven ${COMPONENT_NAME} in React (TypeScript) using Tailwind from the given Figma node. @${FIGMA_LINK}

requirements.rule: Map Figma variants and properties (Figma-defined only) to props; naming consistent with Figma where sensible
Support controlled and uncontrolled usage when applicable
Include label, helper text, icons, slots, or actions if present in Figma
Accessibility: semantic HTML, roles, label association, aria-describedby, keyboard, focus-visible

design_rules.rule: Cover state matrix: Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled × Selected/Open/Error/size as in Figma
Map static State props to real props only when needed (e.g. disabled); hover/focus/active via CSS
Visuals match tokens: spacing, typography, color, border, radius, shadow
Smooth transitions where Figma implies interaction feedback
Reusable across screens; compatible with Figma Code Connect

code_connect.rule: Maintain *.figma.tsx with figma.connect(component, FIGMA_LINK, props, example)
Document which Figma states are prop-driven vs CSS-only

tailwind_dom.rule: peer-* applies only to following siblings of .peer; do not use peer-checked on deeply nested children
Use group + group-has-[:checked] / group-has-[:disabled] or JS state for inner indicators
Opaque inputs: preserve hit area and z-index for decorative layers

style_guide.rule: Prefer theme tokens (e.g. maps-* colors, font-maps-*, text-maps-*) from tailwind config / design-system styles
Avoid raw hex/px in components; if missing from theme, add once to styles (e.g. colors.ts) then use token

constraints.rule: Not static: state-driven, conditional Tailwind classes
Export types and barrel exports consistent with existing components
Run build or tsc after implementation

post_process.step: Refactor stray literals into tokens where possible
Align exports and patterns with existing components
File comment: Figma reference and intentional deviations
